Commentary.Commentary: Right then, West Indies qualify for the final with this win. That means only one out of Bangladesh and Ireland can come in. Ireland will hope for Bangladesh to lose both their remaining games, one of which is against Ireland themselves. The next game though is West Indies versus Bangladesh on the 13th of May, Monday at 1045 local (0945 GMT) where the former will be looking for revenge for the earlier loss in the series. If Bangladesh win that one, Ireland will be out of reckoning. Do join for us that one then. Till then, it is goodbye from us. Cheers!

Victorious West Indies skipper, Jason Holder says that it is a very good victory. Credits Sunil Ambris and all the other batsmen who supported him. Tells that he was happy to bowl first but in the end, it was one of those wickets where one had to see how it plays. He mentions that they want to keep improving every game and that it was really nice to see the boys chase a daunting target of 300-plus which gives them confidence going ahead.

Ireland skipper, William Porterfield says that it is a tough loss. He feels that the wicket was slightly tricky to start with and praises his batsmen who batted well. He reckons that the pitch slowed up a bit and bowling became tough and that the total just wasn't enough. Showers praise on Andy Balbirnie saying he is world class and that he has been in great form, and it is great for him and the side. Signs off by telling it was a good game of cricket.

Sunil Ambris is the Man of the Match. He says that he is very, very happy to have won the game for his side and tells that he is very lucky to have got the opportunity to bat in that spot (opening). Reckons the pitch was a really nice one to bat on. Signs off by saying that this kind of batting performance definitely spurs one on.

Well about the bowling of Ireland, not much can be said. It was always going to be tough to bowl on this surface and that was exactly what happened. They got carted all around the field by Ambris and co. and in the end, failed desperately in the attempt to defend 327. Rankin did get 3 wickets but was very expensive just like the others who did not look like having too much of an impact. All this meant that West Indies recorded their highest ever run-chase in ODIS! Stay tuned for the presentation.

Chasing 328, the away side needed a good start and that is what they got scoring 73 runs in the Powerplay. Hope did not last too long post that but almost every batsman who came in contributed. Sunil Ambris though took the opportunity by the scruff of the neck and ensured he made it count. An incredible 148 off just 126 balls along with significant knocks from others meant that the boys from the Caribbean got over the line with ease.

This has been a brilliantly engineered chase. West Indies have coasted to victory and go to the top of the table after 3 games played. They also confirm a place in the final with this win. Credit to a brilliant hundred by Sunil Ambris. He totally guided the chase and the rest played around him.

FOUR! That is it! It is all over here for Ireland! A superlative chase from the West Indies. THEY WIN BY 5 WICKETS with 13 balls to spare! Coming to the winning shot, it was not too convincing but no one cares. A length ball outside off, Carter looks to cut but gets an outside edge that goes just wide of the keeper's reach for a boundary. Celebrations in the West Indies' camp.
Fabian Allen is the new batsman in but he will not be on strike as the batsmen crossed ends when the catch  was taken.

OUT! Oh no, what an anti-climax. Holder goes for the grandstand finish but ends up holing out. A length ball outside off, Jason looks to clear the long off boundary with a lofted shot but fails to time the ball as well as he would have liked it. The ball ends in the hands of Porterfield. Ireland live another ball.
FOUR! A short delivery which has been pulled away ferociously. The ball has crossed the ropes in a canter. Four runs have been signalled by the umpire. What a shot. Just 1 needed now.

SIX! Holder seems to be in a hurry to end this game. A length ball outside off, Jason lofts it over long off. High and handsome over the boundary ropes for a maximum. The umpire raises his arms in the air to signal a six.
Length delivery outside off, Carter guides it towards third man for a run.
Boyd Rankin now comes back on.
Length delivery on middle, Carter flicks it towards square leg for a single. 19 runs have come from the last two overs. West Indies need just 12 runs to win the match.

FOUR! A desperate effort in the deep but the ball has gone to the boundary. A fuller slower ball on the pads, Carter sweeps this aerially through backward square leg. The ball goes to the right of O'Brien who tries to keep it in but can't do so.
Full on middle, Carter flicks it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! That has just dropped the dropping shoulders of the Irish even further. A short ball on middle, Carter pulls it through square leg and finds the rope. Brilliant shot and at much-needed time.
Length delivery on off, Jason plays it towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
Short delivery on middle, Holder pulls it over mid-wicket. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Joshua Little comes back on for his final over.
Full on off, Holder drives it towards mid off for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Holder lets it go.
50 partnership between Jonathan Carter and Jason Holder. Tossed up on off, Holder plays it towards covers for a single.
Floated on middle, Carter flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.

Has he kept that inside? A valiant effort from Kevin O'Brien at long on. A flighted ball from Dockrell on middle, Carter hits it to the right of long on where the big, burly guy runs and stops the ball but not fully. He manages to pull back the rolling ball back in just in time. Saves 3 runs for his team as the batsmen have only run one. 300 comes up for West Indies!
Full on off, Holder drives it through covers for a run.
Short on off, Carter makes room and cuts it towards point for a single.

Short of a length, jammed away to deep cover for a couple of runs. Dockrell runs to the ball to keep it in but fails to stop 2. 13 runs off this over, probably the game-deciding one. Just 31 needed now in 30 balls.
Pushed uppishly towards long on. Couple of runs are taken as the fielder in the deep fumbles. Sloppy from Ireland at this stage in the game.
SIX! Fuller length and it is punished! Adair looks on in despair. A half-volley outside off, Holder lifts the ball high and handsome over long off. Pressure-releasing hit!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Chipped over mid-wicket for three runs! Excellent running and fielding both! The fielder in the deep runs to his right and saves a run for his team with a brilliant stop.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven to mid off by the lefty. No run taken.
Mark Adair replaces Joshua Little.
Tossed up on off, Carter plays it towards covers for a single. 7 runs have come from the over. West Indies need 44 runs in 36 balls to win the match.
Full on middle, Holder drives it towards mid on. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Holder nudges it towards square leg. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Tossed up on middle, Carter plays a reverse sweep towards point for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Holder drives it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Carter flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
George Dockrell is back on.

A great effort in the deep there and George Dockrell and Kevin O'Brien have combined to save 2 runs here for their team. Fuller one outside off, Holder drives this uppishly through point. Dockrell from deep cover runs to his left and stops the ball with a dive and just before touching the rope, throws the ball to O'Brien there. He has done really well as the replays too show the ball has been kept it! Two valuable runs saved.
Full on middle and leg, Carter flicks it towards square leg for a single.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Carter looks to go after it but misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Holder nudges it towards square leg for a run.
On a length on middle, Jason flicks it to the leg side.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Holder looks to cut but misses it.
Length delivery on middle, Carter flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length on middle, Carter flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run. 11 runs have come from the over. West Indies need 57 runs in 48 balls to win the match.
WIDE! Rankin bowls it down the leg side, Carter looks to go after it but misses it.

SIX! Lifted over long off with such ease. A length ball on middle, Carter comes a little outside the line to free his arms. Once he has done that, it is all too easy to deposit the ball over the long off boundary.
Short on off, Carter cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Length delivery on middle, Carter nudges it to the leg side.
Full and outside off, Holder drives it through covers. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on middle, Holder drives it towards mid on.

FOUR! That will release some pressure. A fuller one on off, Carter smashes the ball past the bowler and through the left of mid off for a boundary. Just the end to the over that West Indies would have wanted. 8 runs off this over, 68 needed off 54 now.
Length delivery on off, Holder guides it towards third man for a run.
On a length and outside off, Carter dabs it towards third man. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on middle, Jason flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
BEATEN! Good length delivery outside off, Holder looks to chase that ball but misses it as he plays down the wrong line.
Length delivery on middle, Carter flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Powerplay 3 is signalled. Five fielders allowed outside the inner circle. West Indies need 76 runs in 60 balls to win the match. Also, their skipper Jason Holder is the new batsman in.

OUT! The marathon innings comes to an end! Rankin has done the magic trick here. The last ball of Powerplay 2 has brought a wicket and Ireland now believe with 2 quick wickets. A short ball outside off, Ambris looks to cut the ball but cannot keep it down. The ball flies to short third man where Andy McBrine takes another catch, his second as substitute. Is this game turning? Nevertheless, a brilliant knock of 148 comes to a close.
Length delivery on off, Carter dabs it towards third man for a run.
Full on off, Ambris drives it towards mid off for a single.
On a good length on middle, Carter looks to defend but gets an inside edge. It just misses the stumps. It goes towards the leg side for a run. 250 up for West Indies.
Length delivery outside off, Ambris guides it towards third man for a run.
SIX! Powerful shot. Full on middle, Ambris lofts this over the bowler's head for a biggie. This is excellent batting from Sunil Ambris.
Boyd Rankin replaces Tim Murtagh.
Length delivery outside off, Ambris guides it towards third man for a run. 3 runs and a wicket from the over. Productive over for Ireland.
Length delivery on leg, Carter flicks it towards square leg for a single and gets off the mark.

Loud, loud appeal but not out says the umpire. A length ball to the new batsman from over the wicket on off. Carter misses the flick and gets hit near the knee roll. The appeal goes up in unison but the umpire turns it down. Looked pretty adjacent, unfortunatelu for Little and Ireland though, it has been given not out.
Jonathan Carter is the new batsman in.

OUT! The partnership has been broken by Little! Chase won't be there till the end of the chase. A length ball from around the wicket, angled into the right-hander. Roston misses the ball, it goes on the pad and then to peg the leg stump back. Chase misses out on a half ton by 4 runs. Can this wicket inspire Ireland to make a comeback in the game that seemed to be going so smoothly for West Indies?
On a good length and outside off, Chase leaves it alone.
Full on off, Ambris drives it straight past the bowler towards mid off for a run.
On a length and outside off, Ambris dabs it towards third man for a single. Tim Murtagh finishes his spell with figures of 10-0-62-0.
Good length delivery on off, Sunil plays it to point.
Length delivery outside off, Ambris guides it to short third man.
Length delivery outside off, Chase plays it through point. The batsmen change ends.
Punched down to long on for a single by Sunil.

Loud appeal but turned down! A length ball landing outside off and coming inward, keeps a tad low as well. Ambris misses his whip and gets hit on the pad in front of off and the Ireland fielders and bowler appeal. The umpire though has turned it down. Probably the height or an inside edge could have been the reason. Looked pretty adjacent though.
On a length on off, Ambris drives it through covers. The batsmen cross ends. West Indies need 92 runs in 78 balls.
Full on off, Roston drives it to long off for a run.
On a good length on off, Chase defends it from the back foot.
Full on middle, Roston drives it back towards the bowler.
Short again on middle, Sunil pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Chase pulls it through square leg for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Chase flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run. 9 runs have come from the over.
On a length on leg, Ambris flicks it towards short fine leg for a run.
Full on middle, Chase drives it towards mid on for a single.

FOUR! Edged but four. A length ball outside off, Chase looks to cut the ball  but gets an outside edge that goes past the keeper and fine to the third man boundary. Everything going the way of West Indies here. They need less than 100 now.
Length delivery on off, Ambris drives it towards mid off for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Chase drives it towards mid on for a single.

Drinks break! The away side is coasting to a brilliant chasing win here. They are scoring boundaries at will and also picking up the singles and doubles. Ireland seem to have run out of ideas and are waiting for the batsmen to make a mistake. They need a wicket desperately or this game could be over soon. The equation is now 105 off 90.
Ambris watchfully keeps this ball out. 8 runs off this one, West Indies doing this easily as of now.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. One run added to the total. Not much timing but the ball went in the gap.
FOUR! Class stamped all over that. A fuller length ball on middle, Chase drives this through mid-wicket past mid on to his right for a boundary.
Chase stylishly drives this ball to mid off. No run as the ball goes straight to the fielder.
Wide! Slower ball gone wrong. Adair bowls this down the leg side and the batsman tries to put bat on it but cannot. Wide given though.
Decent stop. A dab from Ambris as he tries to run it down fine past short third man but Murtagh there stop the ball with a dive. Keeps the batsmen down to one.

Fuller length outside off, driven wide of cover by Chase. He wants the second run but Ambris does not want to risk the arm of Dockrell. Good decision in the end as it would have been suicidal had he run.

Lucky! Keeps low outside off, Ambris looks to punch this one but the ball goes off the inside edge and just past leg stump. Two runs picked up easily as the fielder from short fine leg runs there and keeps the ball inside.
Driven back down the ground by the batsman. No run.
Punched off the back foot for a single down to long on by Chase.
Tucked off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.

That brings up the 100-run stand and it has come off just 67 balls! Brilliant partnership this, West Indies coasting on the basis of it. Coming to the ball , it was short of a length outside off, guided away through point for a couple by Chase.
Pushed off the front foot towards mid on. No run though.
Ambris looks to repeat the shot but finds short third man this time.
FOUR! Threads the gap and finds the rope. A length ball wide outside off, cut away by Ambris and he beats point to his left. Runs are leaking here now.
Another punch to this ball on a length wide outside off. Easy single picked up.
Cut away hard by Ambris but straight to deep cover. Single taken.
Played to the point region by the batsman. Dot ball.
Run down to third man for a single by Chase.
Mark Adair is back into the attack.

FOUR! That spoils the over! A bouncer on middle and leg, Ambris comes inside the line and paddle-ramps it over the keeper's head. The ball goes fine on the leg side for a boundary. 200 comes up for the West Indies.
Punched to the left of the bowler where Murtagh runs and stops the ball to prevent the run.
Beaten! Outside off, keeps a little low off a length. Ambris looks to run it down but the ball goes past the outside edge.
Good commitment. The fielder from mid-wicket runs to stop this punched ball from going past him and hence saves a run. Ireland need this and more.
Holder drives this to long on again and gets to the other end.
Short of a length, punched back to long on for a single by Ambris.
Tim Murtagh is back into the attack.

Couple picked up! Excellent running. Punched through covers by Chase and the ball goes to the right of deep cover. The batsmen come back for two and complete it easily. 12 runs off this over, another good one for the chasing side.
The batsman opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.

FOUR! Two on the trot. This time to the right of the same fielder in the deep on the leg side. A short one on middle from around the wicket, Ambris gets right on top of the ball and pulls it through square leg for four.
FOUR! Punished! Glorious shot. Slower ball from over the wicket on a length, Ambris has all the time in the world to wait for the ball and pull it away wide of deep mid-wicket. A boundary results.
Run down to third man for a single by Roston.
Slower ball outside off from around the wicket, Chase looks to pull but is deceived by the change of pace. Misses the ball completely.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to deep cover. One run added to the total as Chase keeps strike. 143 needed in 120 now.
Chase pushes at this flighted ball outside off but the fielder at cover-point dives and stops the run.
Fired in on leg, Chase misses his flick and the ball hits him high on the thigh pad region. Slight appeal and nothing more than that.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.

FOUR! Lovely shot. Brilliant hand-eye coordination along with use of the feet. He comes down the track to this flighted ball on middle before lifting it over covers after getting a little outside the line. Finds the gap and the rope as well.
Flighted on middle, Chase comes ahead and drives this along the ground to long on for a run.
Solid front foot defense to end the over.
Good stop. Punched off the back foot towards cover where Balbirnie makes a good stop. Prevents any run.
Ambris pulls this short one away to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Off the inside half of the bat but it has enough on it to go over the head of mid on and to the boundary. A half-volley on middle that is taken full toll off.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
So close! A length ball on off, Chase looks to punch it on the off side but gets an inside edge that runs fine on the leg side. Single taken! Could have so easily been bowled.
From around the wicket and the ball is sprayed down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Joshua Little is now back on.
The batsman plays the square-Cut. They pick up a single. 5 runs off this over.
Shorter this time outside off, Chase looks to cut but gets beaten.

MAIDEN ODI HUNDRED FOR SUNIL AMBRIS! Hats off to you, young guy! A flatter one outside off, pushed to deep cover for a run and it brings up the landmark. This has been a solid innings in this big chase but it needs to continue.
Pushed wide of cover for a single by Chase.
Cut away wide of point and Ambris wants the second run but then decides against it. Good decision. Sunil is on 99 now.
Flatter on middle, punched back to long on for a run by Chase to bring Ambris on strike. He is on 98!

Length delivery on leg, Chase looks to whip but gets it off his pads. It goes towards fine leg for a run. The umpire gives it as a leg bye. 8 runs have come from the over. West Indies need 163 runs in 138 balls.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Cracked away! Short and punished. Outside off, room to swing his arms and Ambris pulls out the full-blooded shot through mid-wicket. Finds the boundary with ease, moves to 97!
Good length delivery on middle, Ambris defends it out.
Length delivery on off, Chase taps it towards point and takes a quick single.
Wide! Sprayed down the leg side by Rankin, it is wided by the umpire.
Fuller length on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket by Chase.
Full on off, Chase drives it to long off for a run.
Tossed up on off, Ambris drives it through covers for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Chase flicks it through mid-wicket for an easy run.
Pushed towards mid-wicket again by Chase. No run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards mid-wicket.
Ambris runs down the wicket and picks up a single to long off.
George Dockrell comes back on.
Length delivery on off, Ambris guides it towards third man for a run.
Good length delivery on middle, Sunil defends it from the back foot.
Length delivery on off, Chase dabs it towards third man for a single.
Loud appeal for caught behind! Not out! Bowls it down the leg side, Chase looks to flick but misses it. The keeper appeals and then the bowler joins him in the process but the umpire shakes his head.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it towards square leg for a single.

FOUR! Ambris welcomes Rankin back exactly the way he welcomed Murtagh. With a boundary. A short ball which has been pulled away. The ball races to the boundary. The umpire signals four runs. 15o up for West Indies.
Boyd Rankin is back into the attack.
FOUR! Pulled away with ease! A short one on middle, Chase pulls this one through mid-wicket and beats the fielder in the deep. Boundary to end the over.
Tossed up on off, Ambris cuts it towards point for a single.
Tossed up on off, Chase punches it towards point and takes a run.
Floated on off, Ambris plays it towards point and takes a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Ambris dabs it to third man.
Tossed up on middle, Ambris defends it off the back foot.
On a good length on middle, Ambris plays it towards the off side and takes a run. 11 runs have come from the over. Big over for the West Indies.
Tim bowls it on a good length on off, Sunil blocks it off the back foot.
Full on off, Ambris plays it back towards the bowler.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it through square leg. Two runs taken.

FOUR! Two in two. Almost a similar shot. Outside off on a fuller length, another loft over mid off and even though this one does not have the timing of the previous ball, it still has enough to go to the fence. Moves to 80!

FOUR! Welcome back, Murtagh says Ambris. A half-volley outside off, Sunil lifts this one right through the line and finds the fence. What a way to make a statement. SA is really batting well out here.
Tim Murtagh is back on.
Flighted delivery on off, Chase comes down the track and defends it out.
Tossed up on off, Ambris plays it towards point for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Sunil defends it from the front foot.
Tossed up on off, Ambris keeps it out.
Full on middle, Chase drives it towards mid on for a run.
Floated on middle, Ambris flicks it towards square leg for a single.
The batsman guides it to third man. They pick up a single. A terrific over for the West Indies, 12 runs off it. They needed this.

FOUR! Short and pulled away! What a good shot! Ambris times this one beautifully off the middle of the bat and beats the fielder who had to move just a little to his right but fails to do so and is beaten by the ball just because of timing!
FOUR! Just bounces inside the rope. Breaks the shackles with that shot does Ambris! A fuller length ball on middle and Sunil lifts it with one flow over the head of the bowler. Almost a biggie!
Length delivery on middle, Chase flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Full again on off, Chase drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it with a slide. The batsmen get two runs.
Full on middle, Chase drives it to mid on.
Mark Adair is back into the attack.
Flighted delivery on off, Sunil defends it off the back foot. 1 run and a wicket from the over. Excellent over from Paul Stirling.
Tossed up on middle, Sunil defends it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on off, Ambris defends it out.
Flighted delivery on middle, Chase punches it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed up on off, Chase plays it to point.
Roston Chase is the new batsman in.

OUT! Guess what! Stirling has broken the partnership! Darren Bravo has fallen against the run of play and to an absolute needless shot. A flighted ball outside off, enticing the batsman into the lofted shot. Bravo hits it right down the throat of long off where the substitute fielder, McBrine takes an easy but sharp catch. Darren is disgusted with himself but he can blame no one but himself for throwing this huge opportunity away. Ireland had a few tight overs and the wicket has come for them!
On a good length on off, Ambris defends it off the back foot.
Length delivery on middle, Bravo flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Good length delivery on off, Bravo keeps it out.
Short delivery on middle, Ambris pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery on middle, Bravo pulls it through square leg for a run.
Short and outside off, Ambris cuts it through point for a single.

Drinks break! West Indies have lost Shai Hope here in the chase but the pitch looks a really easy one to score runs on and they are coasting as of now. They would love for this partnership to continue at least for the next 15-20 overs and that would mean, the chase will be set up easily. Ireland need a wicket or two to just stop the run flow and put some pressure on the chasing side.
Tossed up on middle, Bravo defends it out. Just 3 runs from the over. Good start from Stirling.
Flighted delivery on middle, Darren keeps it out.
Tossed up on off, Sunil defends it towards covers and takes a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Ambris defends it off the front foot.
Floated on off, Bravo drives it to long off for a single.
Tossed up on off, Ambris drives it to long off for a run.
Paul Stirling to roll his arm over now.
Full on middle, Bravo flicks it just behind square on the leg side. The batsmen get two runs.
Length delivery on off, Ambris dabs it towards third man for a single.
On a length and outside off, Bravo plays it through point for a run.
Length delivery on off, Ambris guides it towards third man for a single.
Punched off the back foot towards cover.
On the pads, flicked away to deep fine leg for a run by Bravo. That brings up the 100 for the West Indies! Been a good start for them.
Joshua Little comes back on.
Floated on off, Bravo punches it towards point for a single. West Indies need 229 runs in 204 balls.
Flighted delivery on off, Sunil plays it towards point for a run.
BEATEN! Tossed up just outside off, Ambris looks to cut but misses it due to the spin on this one.
Floated on middle, Darren plays it towards mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Bravo defends it off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, Ambris comes down the track and hits it towards mid off for a run.
Short delivery, Ambris pulls it through square leg. The batsmen cross ends.
Full on middle, Bravo flicks it towards mid-wicket where the fielder goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it. The batsmen take a single.
On a length on leg, Ambris nudges it towards square leg for a run.
Length delivery on middle, Bravo flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on middle, Bravo defends it out.
On a good length and outside off, Bravo shoulders his arms to this one.
Short delivery outside off, Bravo makes room and cuts it through point for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Darren plays it to mid-wicket.
Floated on middle, Bravo flicks it to square leg.

FOUR! Bravo gets his first boundary and quite a classy shot to pick it up too. Short and wide outside off, Darren rocks back and cuts the ball away late. Puts the ball behind square on the off side and deep cover had no chance to come around and stop that one.
Flighted delivery on middle, Darren nudges it to the leg side.
Tossed up on off, Darren blocks it well.
Length delivery on middle, Darren flicks it towards square leg for a run. 5 runs and a big wicket of Shai Hope from the over. Productive over for Ireland.
On a good length and outside off, Bravo offers no shot.
WIDE! Bowls a short ball down the leg side, Bravo lets it go.
Darren Bravo is the new batsman in.

OUT! Big, big wicket! What a catch to bring down the downfall of Hope. A short ball outside off, cut away uppishly by Shai towards point. James McCollum there leaps to his right and holds on with both hands. Brilliant take! It ends the 84-run opening stand and can possibly pave a way back into the game for Ireland. This stand was taking it away from them but this wicket of Hope, who has more than 300 runs in 3 games is now gone.
Good length delivery on off, Shai defends it off the back foot.
Short delivery on middle, Hope pulls it through mid-wicket. The fielder does well to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen get two runs.
Floated on off, Ambris guides it towards third man for a single.
Flighted delivery on off, Shai blocks it well.
Floated on off, Hope blocks it off the back foot.
Tossed up on off, Hope looks to cut but gets a bottom edge on this one.

Fifty for Ambris! His first in ODIS! What a brilliant attacking innings this has been from him. West Indies needed this kind of start while chasing a big total and he has provided it to them. A back foot punch past the bowler to long off takes him to the landmark with a run.
Flighted delivery on off, Ambris keeps it out.
Tossed up on middle, Hope plays it towards mid on for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Hope flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs. 6 runs have come from the over.
Good length delivery on off, Sunil dabs it towards third man for a single.
FOUR! Beats both deep square leg and deep fine leg to perfection. Straying onto the pads is Rankin and Ambris just flicks it away in the gap for a boundary. Runs flowing here.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris blocks it well.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it to mid-wicket.
Rankin starts with a short delivery outside off, Ambris cuts it to point.
Powerplay 2 time! 4 fielders can be outside the circle now till the end of the 40th over. Boyd Rankin is into the attack.
Hope keeps this out from the crease. West Indies are 73/0 at the end of Powerplay 1. 12 runs off this over, the first one from Dockrell.
FOUR! Stand and deliver from Shai Hope! What a shot! Flatter on middle, cut away by Hope and he finds the gap as well. The rope is peppered once more.
Flighted delivery on middle, Hope defends it from the front foot.

Cheeky! Flatter outside off, Ambris takes it almost off his off stump as he pats the ball fine past short third man. The batsmen come back for third as the fielder keeps the ball in with a diving stop. Brilliant running.
FOUR! Poor ball! Short and wide outside off, Ambris has all the time in the world to rock back and cut it through covers. The ball finds the fence.
Tossed up on off, Hope drives it to long off for a run.
Spin time! George Dockrell comes into the attack now.
Good length delivery on off, Sunil keeps it out.
Length delivery on off, Sunil plays the paddle sweep to the leg side.
On a good length on middle, Ambris blocks it off the back foot.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris defends it from the crease.
Full on middle, Hope drives it straight past the bowler to long on for a run. He completes 300 runs in the series.
Murtagh bowls it on a length on middle, Hope plays it to mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! This is even better! Short outside off once more, cut away with power. The ball goes through the exact same region once more and finds the ropes. Second consecutive boundary.
FOUR! The short of length delivery has been cut away through square on the off side. Hope is so good at these shots! No one even moved.
WIDE! Bowls it wide outside off, Ambris shoulders his arms to this one.
Bowls a bouncer, Ambris lets it sail through to the keeper.
Length delivery on middle, Hope tucks it towards square leg for a quick single.
Dabbed down to third man for a single by Ambris. That brings up the 50 for the West Indies.
Good length delivery on off, Hope defends it out.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris nudges it towards square leg for a single.
On a length on middle, Ambris nudges it to the leg side.
FOUR! Amazing shot. Full on middle, Ambris flicks it beautifully through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full on off, Ambris looks to flick but gets a leading edge. It goes towards covers. The batsmen get two runs.
Good length delivery on off, Sunil defends it off the back foot.
Short delivery, Ambris pulls it towards mid on for a run. 8 runs have come from the over. 15 runs have come from the last two.
Length delivery on middle, Hope flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Amazing shot. Length delivery outside off, Hope slaps it through covers for a boundary.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris plays it towards point and takes a single.
Length delivery on middle, Hope flicks it towards square leg. The batsmen take a run.
On a length and outside off, Hope plays it to covers.
Josh Little comes into the attack!
Good length delivery on off, Shai plays it off the front foot towards the off side and takes a quick run.
Length delivery on off, Sunil dabs it towards third man for a run.
On a good length on off, Ambris defends it out.
Good length delivery on middle, Ambris defends it off the back foot.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Full on middle, Ambris lofts it over mid on for a boundary. He is releasing the pressure from Shai Hope.
Length delivery on middle, Hope flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Excellent driver but the fielder at mid off, Porterfield dives to his left and stops the ball with a tumble. A single is taken though and Hope retains strike for the next over.
Punched off the back foot towards cover by Shai.
On top of off, Ambris comes ahead to defend. The ball goes off the inner half to the right of mid on, allowing for a run to be taken.
Cut away but straight to the point fielder by Ambris.
Back of a length, Hope misses his flick. The ball goes off his thigh pad and past slip for a leg bye.
FOUR! The chase by Boyd Rankin but he loses it to the ball. On the pads, flicked away easily past mid-wicket. The fielder runs behind the ball in a teasing chase. The ball wins in the end.
Good length delivery on off, Ambris defends it out. 10 runs have come from the over. Big one for the West Indies.
Length delivery on off, Ambris plays it to point.
FOUR! Nice shot. First six of this innings. Full and outside off, Ambris lofts it over long off for a maximum.
Short delivery outside off, Sunil cuts it through point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Length delivery on middle, Ambris flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Full and outside off, Ambris looks to drive but gets a leading edge. It goes towards point. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Good single. Quick one on middle, tucked towards square leg by Ambris. His partner sets off and calls him through for the run.
Tucked down fine on the leg side for a single.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! On the pad, a half-volley yes but it still has to be put away. Hope does exactly that. Flicks it past mid-wicket to his right. No chance of stopping that.
Fuller outside off, driven to cover by Hope. It was timed well but not the placement that was required.
On a length and on top of middle, Hope pats it back down the ground.
Sprays the first one down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.
Mark Adair to bowl with the other new ball.
Length delivery on middle, Sunil flicks it to mid-wicket. 3 runs have come from the over. Good start from Ireland's point of view.
On a good length on off, Ambris defends it from the back foot.
Full again on middle, Ambris flicks it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Full on middle, Ambris flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Ambris defends it off the back foot.
Murtagh starts with a length delivery on middle, Hope tucks it towards mid-wicket and gets off the mark with a single.
We are back for the chase. The players and umpires are out in the middle. Shai Hope and Sunil Ambris will open the batting for West Indies. Tim Murtagh will start the proceedings for Ireland.
